definitions.turns: Completed normal turns plus one Final Orbit turn; interrupted normal turn becomes that final turn.
definitions.goats: Sum of Goat Count, not number of physical cards.
definitions.win_rate: Fractional win credits / games; equal winners share one win credit.
definitions.wait_turns: Owner's turn counter at play/discard/end minus counter at acquisition; never global turns.
definitions.quick_use: Played within 0, 1, or 2 owner turns after acquisition, divided by all acquisitions.
definitions.least_used: Never played OR played 10+ owner turns after acquisition, divided by all acquisitions.
definitions.held_10_plus: Actually held 10+ owner turns, whether played, discarded, or left in hand.
definitions.played: Includes automatic Nanny placement and reactions; blocked attempts still count as used.
definitions.resolved: The play's effect resolved; this is not a measurement of later strategic benefit.
definitions.late_acquisitions: Cards with fewer than two future owner turns at game end; raw rates are not survival-adjusted.
